theorems.statement: ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (y : Euclid P) (ρ δ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ HasCompactSupport ζ ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ closedBall y (ρ + δ) ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z ∧ ζ z ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ z ∈ closedBall y ρ, ζ z = 1) ∧ (∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖ ≤ C₀ / δ) ∧ ∀ z, z ∉ ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ → fderiv ℝ ζ z = 0
